name: Spanish guitar for a dinner party: farruca, Dirty Flamenco
description: A farruca on solo Spanish guitar, played live. It's a traditional style of flamenco, and Dirty Flamenco's guitarist can play it at your dinner party.
more: Gary Meyers leads Dirty Flamenco, and he studied flamenco for more than ten years. He has played a solo residency at Casa Bonita and was the solo flamenco guitarist at JING Denver. His album is called Desperado's Shade.
